🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A man, maybe 20s, with calloused knuckles heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
👁 It waits for YOU to come close — the stillness is the trap. Spot the shape before you're in reach, and strike first. It only gets one.

📨 Word came: a young hunter wants to join Haven. "I can work. That's all I'm selling." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.

👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.

Recipe: Pit Trap (Level 1). A pit with stakes in the bottom. Dig it on a trail, brush it over, wait.
